obligation: N046 — LITERATURE_FRONTIER (S026 §86, §87; S027 user-directed; DOC-DIAGNOSIS; web/CPU). Deep arXiv research wired to the codebase, recommending registry additions that N043 does not already cover.
web_access_note: arXiv titles/dates/abstracts fetched 2026-08-24 via web_search and export.arxiv.org id_list. CUDA numbers from papers are not Metal results (S026 §89).
survey_emphasis: 2026 and late-2025, with 2024 seeds only when N043 named them or they are the cheapest discriminator
rank_method: rank_score = info_gain * physical_upside / experiment_cost (S026 §114 expected value; §86 census). Scores are 1-5 integers. No single S026 §3 axis decides; each row names one primary axis.

graph_organ_bound_not_dispatch_bound.implication: Do not expect a dispatch cut to buy throughput proportionally. The ledger itself is the deliverable.

one_line: N046 literature frontier: 49 arXiv hypotheses wired to Qwen3.8 organs (whole-model complete EBPW 2.5969, MLP floor 2.25). 24 recommended additions beyond the N043 seed. Literature is not a verdict. CUDA is not Metal.
question: Which 2025-2026 arXiv techniques, not already in the N043 DoctorTechniqueRegistry seed or our negative science, map onto a specific Hawking organ/gap and are worth a cheap falsifying experiment?
answer: Highest EV additions: HIGGS (Hadamard+MSE-grid on MLP, in-tree RHT), TEAL (activation-magnitude histogram on real X), LayerSkip/binary-as-draft (S026 §63; hawking-speculate exists), QTIP (in-tree trellis), Quamba2 (DeltaNet in_proj, 20.7% params), OCTOPUS/OSCAR/TurboQuant (GQA KV; session state already exceeds MODEL_BYTES at 32K×4), native MTP census (expect ABSENT). Do not reopen shared-basis, weight low-rank residual, CSR-sparse, 5-in-8 ternary, or CompactifAI/Tucker on this parent.

techniques.name: HIGGS
techniques.authors: Malinovskii, Panferov, Ilin, Guo, Richtárik, Alistarh
techniques.mechanism: Hadamard incoherence + MSE-optimal Gaussian grids (data-free); linearity theorem maps per-layer ℓ2 to PPL for non-uniform bit allocation.
techniques.hawking_gap: q2f 2.25 is grouped-absmax, not Hadamard+MSE-grid. strand-quant already has RHT (rht.rs) used as an incoherence preprocessor. N044 tests rotation; HIGGS is rotation + a different codebook than q2f's 4-level grid.
techniques.metal_note: Hadamard can be absorbed (S026 §9) or applied online. Online FWHT on X is extra traffic. Grid lookup can reuse LUT paths; C4 refused VQ-PQ, not MSE-grid scalar. CUDA HIGGS kernels ≠ Metal.
techniques.expected_physical_win: Cheapest coordinate+codebook probe that could move MLP below 2.25 without QAT. If HIGGS at 2.0 fails composition, QTIP (trellis) is next, not another grouped-absmax bit.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: CPU: apply sequency-Hadamard (or RHT from strand-quant) to L31.gate_proj, quantize with an MSE-optimal 2- or 3-bit Gaussian grid including scales in EBPW; score composition_local_survives on real hold X vs q2f. Identity and shuffled-Hadamard controls.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: Not in N043 seed. Data-free, cheaper than SpinQuant training, maps onto in-tree RHT, is the cheap discriminator before QTIP.

techniques.name: Gloeckle MTP / Qwen-native MTP census
techniques.mechanism: Train extra heads to predict tokens t+2..t+k; at decode they are a free (or cheap) draft. DeepSeek/Qwen later shipped native MTP.
techniques.hawking_gap: NOETIC_OPERATION_CENSUS geometry has vocab 248320 and no mtp/speculative fields (surveyed). lm_head streams 3.125 EBPW (ORGAN_DENSITY_FLOORS). Extra heads would add to every decode step (S026 §36).
techniques.metal_note: If heads are absent, there is nothing to run. If present, they are extra GEMVs on the existing lm_head kernel path.
techniques.expected_physical_win: Zero unless heads exist in the parent. Census is the experiment.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Read parent config / operation census / tensor names for mtp, speculative, extra_lm_head. Expected: ABSENT. Then stop; do not train MTP on 27B.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: S026 §59 native Qwen MTP census is not Medusa. One file-read experiment. Register so it is not skipped.

techniques.name: TEAL
techniques.authors: Liu, Ponnusamy, Cai, Guo, Kim, Athiwaratkun
techniques.mechanism: Training-free magnitude pruning of hidden states (40–50% model-wide) so weight tiles whose activations are ~0 are not read.
techniques.hawking_gap: ProSparse is N043 (ReLU-fication). TEAL keeps SwiGLU. BYTES_FRONTIER sparse 2% CSR fused was compute-bound. S026 §41-46: ZERO_EXECUTION sparsity only if structured + beats dense. mlp_gate_up is memory-class (360.7 GB/s of 778.8) — skipped reads would move token_ns IF the kernel does not gather.
techniques.metal_note: Unstructured skip = gather = N033 loss. Need a structured (channel/group) mask so the existing tpr64 kernel jumps tiles. CUDA sparse GEMM is not Metal.
techniques.expected_physical_win: If 40% of MLP channels are near-zero on real decode X, up to ~0.4 of mlp_gate_up's 5.29 ms recoverable ns, without touching 2.25 EBPW.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Histogram |x| per channel on real post-attn-norm X (ORGAN_DENSITY_FLOORS capture). If 40% channels are not near-zero, TEAL is dead on this parent. CPU. No kernel.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: Training-free successor of ProSparse that keeps SwiGLU. One histogram falsifies it. Not the CSR sparse we already killed.

techniques.name: LayerSkip
techniques.mechanism: Self-speculative decoding: early-exit draft with the same weights, remaining layers verify; no extra draft model.
techniques.hawking_gap: S026 §63: the failed 1.25 binary may be a useful DRAFT. BINARY_HEALING: binary is 23.43 ms vs q2f 27.55 and dies at generation. hawking-speculate already has Draft/Verified types and dual KV rollback. NOETIC_OPERATION_CENSUS has no MTP heads.
techniques.metal_note: Verify = existing q2f graph. Draft = existing binary graph or first k layers of q2f. No new CUDA kernel to port. Acceptance is the unknown, not Metal.
techniques.expected_physical_win: The only axis that bypasses the MLP byte wall without reopening 2.25. If mean accept τ≥2 at draft cost < q2f, COMPLETE_TOKEN_NS drops without a denser codec.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: On the 16-token compiler-prose prompt: (a) binary_g64 draft / q2f verify; (b) first 16 layers q2f draft / remaining verify. Report mean accepted length. If τ≈1, self-speculation is dead on this body.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: Not Medusa (no extra heads). Maps onto injured binary + existing speculate crate. Highest EV decode-gravity probe.

techniques.name: SpinQuant
techniques.mechanism: Learn a Cayley-parameterized orthogonal rotation that is absorbed into adjacent weights, reducing activation outliers before low-bit PTQ.
techniques.hawking_gap: MLP coherent floor is CLOSED at 2.25 bpw for grouped-absmax / q2f (QWEN_COMPLETION_RECEIPT, four independent ways). S026 §117 says a parameterization floor is not the function floor; N044 is the cheap discriminator (Hadamard + learned orthogonal vs identity and random non-orthogonal) on real X.
techniques.metal_note: If the rotation is fused into W (S026 §9), decode sees only the existing q2f/q3 kernel. Online rotation at decode is extra GEMV traffic on a bandwidth-bound graph and is not free. CUDA PTQ quality is not a Metal token_ns (S026 §89).
techniques.expected_physical_win: Move the MLP composition barrier below 2.25 (63.6% of params; 1.431 of the 2.597 whole-model EBPW in WHOLE_MODEL_RECOMPOSE) if and only if N044 says ROTATION_MOVES_BARRIER.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: N044 COORDINATE_TRANSFORM_PROBE: Hadamard + one learned/structured orthogonal on L31.gate_proj real hold X; re-fit ternary ~1.58 and binary 1.25 vs unrotated; identity and random non-orthogonal controls; composition_local_survives bar (gain>=0.5, rel_fro<=0.5).
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: N043 PHASE A seed. N044 is the experiment, not a second registry row.

techniques.name: ButterflyQuant
techniques.mechanism: Replace discrete Hadamard with learnable orthogonal butterfly (Givens angles); 128-sample calibration, minutes on one GPU.
techniques.hawking_gap: N044 is Hadamard + learned/structured orthogonal. Butterfly is the 2025 parameterization that is differentiable by construction (Hadamard ±1 is not). C5 refuted generated Hadamard as a bits lever (hold cosine +3.4e-4); a LEARNED butterfly is the reopen, not another FWHT.
techniques.metal_note: Absorb Q into W. Do not run butterfly at decode. Learning the angles is CUDA-or-CPU; inference is the existing Metal matvec. CUDA ≠ Metal (S026 §89).
techniques.expected_physical_win: Same N044 question with a strictly richer rotation family than Hadamard.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Fold into N044: one butterfly block (not full SpinQuant) vs Hadamard vs identity on L31.gate_proj; if butterfly ≉ Hadamard on composition, add this row; if tied, do not.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: More recent than SpinQuant; distinct parameterization (continuous butterfly vs Cayley/Hadamard). N044 should include it as an arm, not a separate GPU campaign.

techniques.name: QTIP
techniques.authors: Tseng, Chee, Sun, Kuleshov, De Sa
techniques.mechanism: Trellis-coded quantization after incoherence processing: stateful decoder gives ultra-high-dimensional codes without exponential codebooks; lookup or compute-based trellis.
techniques.hawking_gap: AQLM/VPTQ are N043 codebook seeds; C4 refused gravity_pq VQ port. QTIP's claim is that VQ dimension capped those methods. strand-quant already contains trellis.rs + RHT + Metal encode probes — the in-tree codec is closer to QTIP than to AQLM.
techniques.metal_note: strand-quant has Metal RHT/trellis encode, not a decode GEMV fused into qwen hybrid. A paper CUDA kernel is not a Metal q2f replacement (S026 §89). Bitshift trellis is the hardware-friendly variant to try first.
techniques.expected_physical_win: If trellis+incoherence composes below 2.25 on MLP (63.6% of params), whole-model complete EBPW moves below 2.60 without touching DeltaNet/GQA floors.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: CPU QTIP-style bitshift trellis on one L31.gate_proj tile using strand-quant trellis, real X, complete EBPW including trellis state/scales; vs q2f composition. If rel_fro loses, stop; do not write a decode kernel.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: Distinct from AQLM (trellis vs additive VQ). In-tree trellis/RHT makes this the cheapest codebook experiment that C4 did not already refuse.

techniques.name: Quamba2
techniques.authors: Chiang, Chang, Frumkin, Wu, Abdelfattah, Marculescu
techniques.mechanism: SSM-specific PTQ: cluster/sort recurrence inputs, per-state-group quant of B/C, offline weight permute for compute-invariance; W4A8/W4A16 for Mamba/Mamba2.
techniques.hawking_gap: DeltaNet is 20.7% of params, floor 3.261 complete EBPW (ws_rtn_q3_g64), 3rd recoverable-ns organ (3.39 ms). in_proj cannot be replaced by state (capacity_ratio_state_over_qkv=0.015, ORGAN_FRONTIERS). Quamba2 is the first SSM-aware PTQ not in N043. Recurrent kernel (qwen38_gated_delta_decode_vi_simd) recovered only 21.6% of DN's 25.9% roof share (DELTANET_ORGAN).
techniques.metal_note: We already have a Metal Gated-Delta decode (widen_f4). Quamba2's CUDA recurrence quant is not that kernel. in_proj GEMVs can reuse q3 g64 (already the floor codec). State-group quant of B/C is the new part (leftover currently billed at 32 bpw in ORGAN_DENSITY_FLOORS).
techniques.expected_physical_win: Leftover A_log/conv/dt_bias/norms are 32-bit in the complete bill. If B/C state params survive q8/q4, DeltaNet complete EBPW moves a little; in_proj at 3.25 is the mass. Real win is a SSM-aware codec for in_proj below 3.25 without killing recurrence.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Grouped q3 vs Quamba2-style clustered quant on L0.in_proj_qkv real X (ORGAN_FRONTIERS per-tensor floor). If clustered ≉ RTN, worth a kernel; if tied, DeltaNet floor stays grouped_absmax.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: No SSM/DeltaNet technique is in the N043 seed. Largest non-MLP density lever (WHOLE_MODEL_RECOMPOSE).

techniques.name: DFlash
techniques.mechanism: Block-diffusion drafter emits a whole block of tokens in one parallel pass from target hidden states (not autoregressive draft).
techniques.hawking_gap: A DFlash 2 drafter for Qwen3.8-27B was released 2026-08 (same parent family). hawking-speculate can host verify+rollback. This is the rare case where an external draft already exists for OUR specimen class.
techniques.metal_note: Drafter inference on M3 Ultra is unmeasured. Diffusion draft is a second graph. CUDA/SGLang 2.7–3.4× is not Metal. Verify must stay lossless (hawking-speculate token_boundary).
techniques.expected_physical_win: If a Qwen3.8-27B DFlash draft runs cheaper than q2f and τ>2, this beats any 0.1 EBPW MLP fight on token_ns.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Do not train. (1) Confirm the public Qwen3.8-27B DFlash weights exist locally or skip. (2) CPU/Metal: one block draft vs parent greedy on 16 compiler-prose tokens; if token agreement <2, dead. GPU lock is N042's — do not take it.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: 2026 parallel draft with a Qwen3.8-27B artifact. Not Medusa. Highest specimen-specific decode hypothesis after LayerSkip.

techniques.name: OCTOPUS
techniques.mechanism: Rotate then jointly quantize coordinate triplets via octahedral direction+norm; fused reconstruction so decode adds no extra bandwidth vs dequant.
techniques.hawking_gap: 2026 successor that beats TurboQuant/PolarQuant at 2-bit KV on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M. Our GQA head_dim is 256 (NOETIC_OPERATION_CENSUS) — triplet codec fits.
techniques.metal_note: Paper's fused Triton reconstruct-on-the-fly is the right shape (no materialize). That is a Metal attention rewrite, not a drop-in. CUDA ≠ Metal.
techniques.expected_physical_win: Best published 2-bit rotation KV as of survey date; still GQA-only on this hybrid.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: After TurboQuant K-head MSE: octahedral triplet on the same head at 2 bits. If MSE does not beat Polar/TurboQuant, skip the fused kernel.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: May 2026 octahedral KV is not KIVI/MiniCache/H2O. Highest-leverage GQA-KV addition.

techniques.name: OSCAR
techniques.authors: Zhou, Zhuang, Li, Chen, Song, Athiwaratkun, Wu
techniques.mechanism: Offline spectral covariance-aware rotation + clipping for 2-bit KV; attention-aligned, not generic Hadamard. Reports near-BF16 on Qwen3-32B / GLM-4.7 at 2.28 bits/KV.
techniques.hawking_gap: Hadamard is N044/C5's default and was weak as a bits lever on weights. OSCAR says KV needs an attention-aware covariance rotation. GQA k_proj gated the ORGAN_FRONTIERS floor.
techniques.metal_note: Offline R can be baked. 2-bit KV still needs a Metal dequant-attention. GLM-4.7 CUDA numbers are not ours.
techniques.expected_physical_win: If covariance rotation beats Hadamard on our GQA K, 2-bit KV becomes plausible; else generic rotation KV is closed.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Estimate K-head covariance from 4K real prefix (one GQA layer); compare 2-bit RTN after (a) identity (b) Hadamard (c) top eigenvectors. CPU.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: 2026 attention-aware KV rotation is not KIVI and not SpinQuant (weights). Cheap covariance probe.

techniques.name: TurboQuant
techniques.mechanism: Random/structured rotation then PolarQuant + 1-bit QJL residual; data-free ~3-bit KV near the distortion bound.
techniques.hawking_gap: KIVI is the N043 KV seed. TurboQuant is the 2025–26 rotation-preconditioned successor. PREFILL_KV: session state exceeds model bytes at 32K×4. GQA KV 33.6 MB at seq 256 is the compressible cache; DeltaNet 156.9 MB state is not a KV codec target.
techniques.metal_note: Needs fused Metal attention over rotated+quantized K. mlx-lm has an open PolarQuant issue — community interest, no Hawking kernel. CUDA H100 8× is not M3 Ultra.
techniques.expected_physical_win: ~4–6× GQA KV. Does not shrink DeltaNet recurrent state.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Hadamard-rotate one GQA K head (d=256) from a 4K capture, Lloyd-Max 3-bit vs KIVI-style per-channel 2-bit; compare reconstruction MSE and a 32-token greedy continuation. CPU.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: ICLR 2026 KV rotation codec is not KIVI. Register; experiment is a CPU K-head MSE.

techniques.name: Medusa
techniques.authors: Cai, Li, Chen, Zhang, Liu, Xing, Keutzer, Song
techniques.mechanism: Extra decoding heads on the last hidden state propose multiple future tokens; target verifies in one pass.
techniques.hawking_gap: hawking-speculate already has n-gram user-draft and DeepSeek shared-expert draft + dual committed/provisional KV. NOETIC_OPERATION_CENSUS has no MTP/Medusa heads (mtp=false). Decode is bandwidth-bound; extra heads add weight traffic unless tiny.
techniques.metal_note: Verify path exists (hawking-speculate). Draft heads need Metal. CUDA Medusa kernels are irrelevant. S026 §89.
techniques.expected_physical_win: Reduce passes-per-token (S026 §59-64). q2f is 27.55 ms/token; accepting k>1 without k× weight reads is the only decode-loop win that bypasses the MLP byte wall.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Census parent for extra lm_heads (expect ABSENT). Then LayerSkip / binary-as-draft, not a new Medusa training run.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: N043 seed. EAGLE-3 / DFlash / LayerSkip are the additions.

techniques.name: PTQTP
techniques.authors: Xiao, Yang, Yang, Xu, Li, Su, Liu, Yang, Wong
techniques.mechanism: Decompose W into dual ternary trit-planes plus scales; additive multiplication-free inference at ~1.58 bpw without QAT.
techniques.hawking_gap: BYTES_FRONTIER ternary_5in8_g64: fewer bytes, same-or-worse COMPLETE_TOKEN_NS because trit unpack ate the byte win. That packing is not PTQTP's dual-plane additive form. Dual-plane native execution does not exist in KERNEL_LIBRARY.
techniques.metal_note: Must execute NATIVE (S026 §17, §27). Reconstruct-to-dense is forbidden. Our ternary geo is already compute-bound; a second plane doubles arithmetic unless fused.
techniques.expected_physical_win: Only if a fused dual-plane kernel is load-bound. Law: fewer stored bits != fewer nanoseconds (REPRESENTATION_LIBRARY).
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: CPU dual-plane residual vs q2f on L31.down_proj real X at matched ~1.58 complete EBPW; if composition dies, stop before writing a Metal kernel (N003).
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: N043 seed. N043 should note our 5-in-8 negative does not close dual-plane PTQTP.
techniques.negative_science: BYTES_FRONTIER.finding.ternary_5in8_g64 is not a PTQTP refutation

techniques.name: ParoQuant
techniques.mechanism: Independent pairwise Givens rotations + channel-wise scaling, co-designed so rotations stay cheap at decode; claims QTIP-level accuracy at ~25% faster.
techniques.hawking_gap: If N044's full orthogonal is too expensive to learn, pairwise Givens is the cheap structured alternative. mlp_gate_up is rank-1 recoverable-ns (5.29 ms).
techniques.metal_note: Paper's CUDA kernel co-design is not Metal. Pairwise rotations can be absorbed. If left online, two-element Givens is cheaper than a dense Q, but still extra bandwidth.
techniques.expected_physical_win: Hardware-efficient cousin of SpinQuant for the N044 reopen.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: N044 arm: independent 2×2 Givens per pair vs full Hadamard; CPU, real X.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: ICLR 2026 pairwise rotation is not SpinQuant. Register as a N044 arm.

techniques.name: ResQ
techniques.authors: Saxena, Alizadeh, Vemuri, Saha, De Sa, Alistarh
techniques.mechanism: PCA on activations: keep a 1/8 high-variance subspace in 8-bit, quantize the rest to 4-bit, with per-subspace random rotation (W4A4KV4).
techniques.hawking_gap: CALDERA/HYBRID killed WEIGHT low-rank residuals. ResQ's low-rank is an ACTIVATION subspace (mixed precision), a different idea. Decode here is weight-bandwidth-bound (ORGAN_ROOF_LEDGER memory class); A4 does not cut weight reads.
techniques.metal_note: W4A4 helps compute-bound prefills more than load-bound decode. Do not import CUDA W4A4 speedups as Metal token_ns (S026 §89).
techniques.expected_physical_win: Possible on prefill (PREFILL_KV is decode-shaped today). Weak on decode token_ns.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: PCA of real MLP activations (capture_diverse2 hold): if 1/8 channels do not dominate variance, ResQ's premise is false on this parent. CPU, no kernel.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: Not CALDERA. Register so Doctor does not conflate activation-subspace mixed precision with the killed weight LR residual.

techniques.name: Sparse Delta Memory
techniques.mechanism: Replace dense GDN outer-product state with sparse reads/writes into a large explicit memory — scale state capacity without dense FLOPs.
techniques.hawking_gap: State/in_proj capacity ratio 0.015: state CANNOT store W (ORGAN_FRONTIERS). PREFILL_KV: DN state 156.9 MB at seq 256, not prefix-shareable. Sparse addressing on Metal is the CSR lesson unless the sparse pattern is regular.
techniques.metal_note: Sparse state is a new kernel family. N033 fused CSR lost on occupancy. Only try if the addressing is blocked/regular.
techniques.expected_physical_win: Could cut DN session state or raise recall at iso-FLOP. Architecture, not a q3 in_proj replacement (0.015 law).
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Do not build a sparse state kernel. Measure GDN state matrix effective rank / sparsity on a 1K real prefix; if dense, SDM's premise is false here.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: 2026 GDN-state compression is not MiniCache/H2O. Directly targets the 0.015 in_proj-irreducible law's OTHER side (state bytes).

techniques.name: CAT-Q
techniques.mechanism: Learnable modulation of weight distribution + softened ternarization in a sliding-layer PTQ pipeline; nearby-weight healing without full QAT.
techniques.hawking_gap: Binary injury is uniform (gate/up/down rel_fro 0.42–0.47; BINARY_HEALING); no protected island restored generation under 27.55 ms. CAT-Q is the S026-named ternary healer. Our 1.25 binary is injured, not dead (S024 §4-9).
techniques.metal_note: Paper reports A100-hour PTQ, not M3 Ultra decode. Healing is a fit; native trit kernel still owed. Do not reconstruct-to-dense (S026 §17).
techniques.expected_physical_win: Restore generation on a <2.25 body. BINARY_HEALING found n_that_reached_coherent_generation=0 for four islands.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: CPU CAT-Q-style softened ternary fit on L0.up_proj (BINARY_HEALING earliest organ) with 512 real-X rows; composition_local_survives vs unhealed ternary; no GPU.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: N043 seed (S026 named CAT-Q). Healing experiment is bounded, not a new family.

techniques.name: HyperQuant
techniques.mechanism: Unified data-free pipeline: per-tile RHT, lattice quantization, bit-stripping, Rice coding, subtractive dither — for both weights and KV.
techniques.hawking_gap: Combines HIGGS-like RHT grids with TurboQuant-like KV. Rice on attention was part of the Gravity families that NNS-003 says cannot carry Qwen3.8 ≤1.5. Medium-bit (3–4) is the honest regime vs our 2.60 whole-model number.
techniques.metal_note: Entropy-coded weights need a decode that does not become CPU-bound. NNS-011: tpr64 recon was free for 32/33 variants — entropy coding may still be eligible on quality, not as a 10–25% speed myth.
techniques.expected_physical_win: A single pipeline for MLP weights + GQA KV, rather than two campaigns.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Run HIGGS (weights) and TurboQuant (KV) probes separately; only unify if both pass composition. Do not implement Rice decode first.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: 2026 unified RHT+lattice+Rice is not AQLM/HIGGS/KIVI. Register as a composition of those probes, not a first GPU build.

techniques.name: TWLA
techniques.authors: Zhao, Xu, Chen, Hu, Jiang, Yang
techniques.mechanism: Ternary-friendly Kronecker orthogonal (KOTMS) plus manifold ternary quantizer and inter-layer-aware W1.58A4 activations.
techniques.hawking_gap: Our ternary_5in8_g64 stored 1.85 bpw but did not move COMPLETE_TOKEN_NS (BYTES_FRONTIER) and whole-model ternary flipped argmax (NOETIC_COMPOSITION_WHOLEMODEL_TERNARY). TWLA is a different coordinate system (Kronecker rotation + ternary), not our 5-in-8 packing. C5 already refuted generated Hadamard as a bits lever on this parent.
techniques.metal_note: W1.58A4 CUDA kernels are not Metal kernels. Our ternary_5in8 geo (bytes_frontier.metal) is SUSPECT and compute-bound at fewer bytes. A native fused trit path is owed before any speed claim (S026 §17, §90).
techniques.expected_physical_win: Reopen ternary only in rotated coords (S026 §11 QWEN_MLP_ROTATED_TERNARY), not by re-running 5-in-8.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: After N044: if rotation moves the barrier, re-fit TWLA-style ternary (not 5-in-8) on L31.gate_proj real X at ~1.58 bpw vs q2f 2.25 composition; if rotation does not move it, close TWLA on this parent.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: N043 seed. Distinguish from our ternary_5in8 negative; do not duplicate the row.
techniques.negative_science: BYTES_FRONTIER ternary_5in8 is a packing negative, not a TWLA negative

techniques.name: EAGLE-3
techniques.mechanism: Direct token prediction from multi-layer fused hidden states (training-time test); draft conditioned on the target, not a small independent LM.
techniques.hawking_gap: Medusa is the N043 seed. EAGLE-3 is the 2025 production draft (vLLM/SGLang). Extra draft net is not free on 96 GB if it duplicates traffic; hawking-speculate's ExactShared path is the in-tree analogue (always-on experts as draft).
techniques.metal_note: Needs a Metal draft net + verify. CUDA EAGLE-3 2–6× is not an M3 Ultra number. Train-cost is real.
techniques.expected_physical_win: Higher τ than Medusa/LayerSkip if trained. Cost is a second model on unified memory.
techniques.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: After LayerSkip/binary-draft. Only if τ stays ~1, consider a small EAGLE-3-style head on last hidden — not a 27B-scale training run.
techniques.add_to_registry_reason: 2025 successor of Medusa with a different draft (multi-layer features, not extra lm_heads). Register; do not train until LayerSkip is measured.

techniques.name: KIVI
techniques.authors: Liu, Zhao, Yu, Huang, Cohan, Zhao
techniques.mechanism: Tuning-free asymmetric 2-bit KV: keys per-channel, values per-token.
techniques.hawking_gap: PREFILL_KV: q4 c=4 at 32K SESSION_STATE 16.59 GiB exceeds MODEL_BYTES 13.32 GiB. GQA is only 6.2% of params but KV grows with context; DeltaNet state is NOT prefix-shareable (NOETIC_CANON law 14).

techniques.name: H2O
techniques.authors: Zhang, Sheng, Shen, Zheng, Chen, Liang, Chen, Song, Zhou
techniques.mechanism: Heavy-hitter oracle: retain tokens with high cumulative attention, evict the rest.

techniques.name: MiniCache
techniques.mechanism: Merge KV states across adjacent depth layers (depth-dimension compression).
techniques.hawking_gap: 16 GQA layers interleaved with 48 DeltaNet layers. Depth-merge of GQA KV is possible; DeltaNet recurrent state is a summary, not a cache, so MiniCache does not transfer to DN layers.

techniques.add_to_registry_reason: N043 seed. Cheap cosine probe can live under that row.

techniques.name: FlatQuant
techniques.mechanism: Learnable per-layer affine (Kronecker-factored) to flatten weights and activations; fused kernel to hide transform cost.

techniques.add_to_registry_reason: Not in N043 seed; distinct from SpinQuant (affine/Kronecker, not orthogonal). Keep as a N044 footnote, not a GPU lane.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: CPU: apply sequency-Hadamard (or RHT from strand-quant) to L31.gate_proj, quantize with an MSE-optimal 2- or 3-bit Gaussian grid including scales in EBPW; score composition_local_survives on real hold X vs q2f. Identity and shuffled-Hadamard controls.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: Not in N043 seed. Data-free, cheaper than SpinQuant training, maps onto in-tree RHT, is the cheap discriminator before QTIP.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: Gloeckle MTP / Qwen-native MTP census
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Train extra heads to predict tokens t+2..t+k; at decode they are a free (or cheap) draft. DeepSeek/Qwen later shipped native MTP.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Read parent config / operation census / tensor names for mtp, speculative, extra_lm_head. Expected: ABSENT. Then stop; do not train MTP on 27B.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: S026 §59 native Qwen MTP census is not Medusa. One file-read experiment. Register so it is not skipped.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: TEAL
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Training-free magnitude pruning of hidden states (40–50% model-wide) so weight tiles whose activations are ~0 are not read.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Histogram |x| per channel on real post-attn-norm X (ORGAN_DENSITY_FLOORS capture). If 40% channels are not near-zero, TEAL is dead on this parent. CPU. No kernel.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: Training-free successor of ProSparse that keeps SwiGLU. One histogram falsifies it. Not the CSR sparse we already killed.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: LayerSkip
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Self-speculative decoding: early-exit draft with the same weights, remaining layers verify; no extra draft model.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: On the 16-token compiler-prose prompt: (a) binary_g64 draft / q2f verify; (b) first 16 layers q2f draft / remaining verify. Report mean accepted length. If τ≈1, self-speculation is dead on this body.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: Not Medusa (no extra heads). Maps onto injured binary + existing speculate crate. Highest EV decode-gravity probe.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: ButterflyQuant
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Replace discrete Hadamard with learnable orthogonal butterfly (Givens angles); 128-sample calibration, minutes on one GPU.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Fold into N044: one butterfly block (not full SpinQuant) vs Hadamard vs identity on L31.gate_proj; if butterfly ≉ Hadamard on composition, add this row; if tied, do not.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: More recent than SpinQuant; distinct parameterization (continuous butterfly vs Cayley/Hadamard). N044 should include it as an arm, not a separate GPU campaign.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: QTIP
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Trellis-coded quantization after incoherence processing: stateful decoder gives ultra-high-dimensional codes without exponential codebooks; lookup or compute-based trellis.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: CPU QTIP-style bitshift trellis on one L31.gate_proj tile using strand-quant trellis, real X, complete EBPW including trellis state/scales; vs q2f composition. If rel_fro loses, stop; do not write a decode kernel.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: Distinct from AQLM (trellis vs additive VQ). In-tree trellis/RHT makes this the cheapest codebook experiment that C4 did not already refuse.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: Quamba2
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: SSM-specific PTQ: cluster/sort recurrence inputs, per-state-group quant of B/C, offline weight permute for compute-invariance; W4A8/W4A16 for Mamba/Mamba2.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Grouped q3 vs Quamba2-style clustered quant on L0.in_proj_qkv real X (ORGAN_FRONTIERS per-tensor floor). If clustered ≉ RTN, worth a kernel; if tied, DeltaNet floor stays grouped_absmax.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: No SSM/DeltaNet technique is in the N043 seed. Largest non-MLP density lever (WHOLE_MODEL_RECOMPOSE).

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: DFlash
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Block-diffusion drafter emits a whole block of tokens in one parallel pass from target hidden states (not autoregressive draft).
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Do not train. (1) Confirm the public Qwen3.8-27B DFlash weights exist locally or skip. (2) CPU/Metal: one block draft vs parent greedy on 16 compiler-prose tokens; if token agreement <2, dead. GPU lock is N042's — do not take it.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: 2026 parallel draft with a Qwen3.8-27B artifact. Not Medusa. Highest specimen-specific decode hypothesis after LayerSkip.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: OCTOPUS
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Rotate then jointly quantize coordinate triplets via octahedral direction+norm; fused reconstruction so decode adds no extra bandwidth vs dequant.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: After TurboQuant K-head MSE: octahedral triplet on the same head at 2 bits. If MSE does not beat Polar/TurboQuant, skip the fused kernel.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: May 2026 octahedral KV is not KIVI/MiniCache/H2O. Highest-leverage GQA-KV addition.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: OSCAR
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Offline spectral covariance-aware rotation + clipping for 2-bit KV; attention-aligned, not generic Hadamard. Reports near-BF16 on Qwen3-32B / GLM-4.7 at 2.28 bits/KV.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Estimate K-head covariance from 4K real prefix (one GQA layer); compare 2-bit RTN after (a) identity (b) Hadamard (c) top eigenvectors. CPU.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: 2026 attention-aware KV rotation is not KIVI and not SpinQuant (weights). Cheap covariance probe.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: TurboQuant
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Random/structured rotation then PolarQuant + 1-bit QJL residual; data-free ~3-bit KV near the distortion bound.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Hadamard-rotate one GQA K head (d=256) from a 4K capture, Lloyd-Max 3-bit vs KIVI-style per-channel 2-bit; compare reconstruction MSE and a 32-token greedy continuation. CPU.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: ICLR 2026 KV rotation codec is not KIVI. Register; experiment is a CPU K-head MSE.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: ParoQuant
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Independent pairwise Givens rotations + channel-wise scaling, co-designed so rotations stay cheap at decode; claims QTIP-level accuracy at ~25% faster.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: N044 arm: independent 2×2 Givens per pair vs full Hadamard; CPU, real X.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: ICLR 2026 pairwise rotation is not SpinQuant. Register as a N044 arm.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: ResQ
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: PCA on activations: keep a 1/8 high-variance subspace in 8-bit, quantize the rest to 4-bit, with per-subspace random rotation (W4A4KV4).
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: PCA of real MLP activations (capture_diverse2 hold): if 1/8 channels do not dominate variance, ResQ's premise is false on this parent. CPU, no kernel.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: Not CALDERA. Register so Doctor does not conflate activation-subspace mixed precision with the killed weight LR residual.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: Sparse Delta Memory
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Replace dense GDN outer-product state with sparse reads/writes into a large explicit memory — scale state capacity without dense FLOPs.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Do not build a sparse state kernel. Measure GDN state matrix effective rank / sparsity on a 1K real prefix; if dense, SDM's premise is false here.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: 2026 GDN-state compression is not MiniCache/H2O. Directly targets the 0.015 in_proj-irreducible law's OTHER side (state bytes).

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: HyperQuant
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Unified data-free pipeline: per-tile RHT, lattice quantization, bit-stripping, Rice coding, subtractive dither — for both weights and KV.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Run HIGGS (weights) and TurboQuant (KV) probes separately; only unify if both pass composition. Do not implement Rice decode first.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: 2026 unified RHT+lattice+Rice is not AQLM/HIGGS/KIVI. Register as a composition of those probes, not a first GPU build.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: EAGLE-3
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Direct token prediction from multi-layer fused hidden states (training-time test); draft conditioned on the target, not a small independent LM.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: After LayerSkip/binary-draft. Only if τ stays ~1, consider a small EAGLE-3-style head on last hidden — not a 27B-scale training run.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: 2025 successor of Medusa with a different draft (multi-layer features, not extra lm_heads). Register; do not train until LayerSkip is measured.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: MagicDec
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Show speculative decoding still wins at large batch/long context because target KV cost grows faster than draft cost.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: After a working draft (LayerSkip/binary). Measure accept τ at seq 4K vs 256. If τ collapses, MagicDec's premise fails on this hybrid (DN state not prefix-shareable).
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: ICLR 2025 long-context speculative policy is not Medusa. Register as production decode-gravity.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: OSTQuant
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Learnable orthogonal + scaling (OST) with KL-Top loss on small calibration; W4 and W4A4KV4.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Covered by N044 if the learned rotation includes a diagonal scale. Do not start a separate OST GPU fit.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: ICLR 2025 orthogonal+scale is not in the N043 name list. Register as SpinQuant-adjacent, experiment = N044.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: Palu
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Low-rank factorization of K/V projections; cache the compressed latent, reconstruct on the fly; stacks with quantization.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: SVD of one GQA k_proj on real X; reconstruct K at rank/2; if complete_token argmax flips on 16 tokens, Palu is dead at 50%. CPU.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: ICLR 2025 KV low-rank is not MiniCache/H2O/KIVI. Not the weight-LR family C1/C3 killed.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: PolarQuant
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Polar-angle parameterization of rotated unit vectors with analytic Lloyd-Max codebooks (TurboQuant stage 1).
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Include as an arm of the TurboQuant K-head MSE (polar vs scalar-after-Hadamard).
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: AISTATS 2026 polar KV is not KIVI. Can share a row with TurboQuant in N043 as polar-stage.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: SuperBPE
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Two-stage BPE: subwords then superwords that cross whitespace; 33% fewer tokens at 200k vocab, +4% downstream at iso-compute (trained from scratch).
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: N045 ASCII-prune control with TOKEN_INFLATION_RATIO on English/code/JSON/paths. SuperBPE is not that control; do not retrain 27B.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: Tokenizer family is N045, not N043 seed. Register SuperBPE as a VocabularyGenome option distinct from ASCII prune.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: FlatQuant
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Learnable per-layer affine (Kronecker-factored) to flatten weights and activations; fused kernel to hide transform cost.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Skip W4A4 replay. One Kronecker-affine (two small matrices) absorbed into W, then q2f re-fit; if composition ≈ baseline, close.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: Not in N043 seed; distinct from SpinQuant (affine/Kronecker, not orthogonal). Keep as a N044 footnote, not a GPU lane.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: Mixture-of-Recursions
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Share layer parameters across recursion steps and route tokens to dynamic recursion depth; optional KV sharing from first recursion.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Do not train 27B MoR. Cosine between layer ℓ and ℓ+1 MLP weights (already C1-adjacent). If still ~0, depth-tying is as dead as coefficient-sharing.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: 2025 MoD successor. Register as Odyssey/architecture, not a Qwen GPU WU.

RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.name: TransMLA
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.mechanism: Convert GQA checkpoints to DeepSeek MLA (latent KV) with short recovery fine-tune; 93% KV cut reported on LLaMA-2.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.cheapest_falsifying_experiment: Do not fine-tune 27B. SVD of concatenated GQA K/V latents on 4K prefix; if rank does not collapse, MLA conversion will need the 6B-token recovery and is Odyssey-cost.
RECOMMENDED_ADDITIONS.reason: GQA→MLA is not KIVI. Register as state-architecture; cheap SVD first.
